title: Assessment of the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor-Mediated Effects of Aromatic Sensitizers in Paper Recycling Effluent Employing Zebrafish Embryos and in Silico Docking.
authors: Takeda, Kazuki; Sarata, Aoi; Terasaki, Masanori; Kubota, Akira; Shimizu, Keita; Kamata, Ryo
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和斑马鱼胚胎评估造纸废水中芳香敏化剂经芳烃受体介导的毒性效应，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子与AHR受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Aromatic sensitizers and related substances (SRCs), which are crucial in the paper industry for facilitating color-forming and color-developing chemical reactions, inadvertently contaminate effluents during paper recycling. Owing to their structural resemblance to endocrine-disrupting aromatic organic compounds, concerns have arisen about potential adverse effects on aquatic organisms. We focused on SRC effects via the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR), employing molecular docking simulations and zebrafish (Danio rerio) embryo exposure assessments. Molecular docking revealed heightened binding affinities between certain SRCs in the paper recycling effluents and zebrafish Ahr2 and human AHR, which are pivotal components in the SRC toxicity mechanism. Fertilized zebrafish eggs were exposed to SRCs for up to 96 h post fertilization; among these substances, benzyl 2-naphthyl ether (BNE) caused morphological abnormalities, such as pericardial edema and shortened body length, at relatively low concentrations (1 muM) during embryogenesis. Gene expression of cytochrome P450 1A (cyp1a) and ahr2 was also significantly increased by BNE. Co-exposure to the AHR antagonist CH-223191 only partially mitigated BNE's phenotypic effects, despite the effects of 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin being relatively well restored by CH-223191, indicating BNE's AHR-independent toxic mechanisms. Furthermore, some SRCs, including BNE, exhibited in silico binding affinity to the estrogen receptor and upregulation of cyp19a1b gene expression. Therefore, additional insights into the toxicity of SRCs and their mechanisms are essential. The present results provide important information on SRCs and other papermaking chemicals that could help minimize the environmental impact of the paper industry. Environ Toxicol Chem 2024;43:2176-2188. (c) 2024 SETAC.
abstract_zh: 芳香族敏化剂及相关物质（SRCs）在造纸工业中对于促进显色和显色化学反应至关重要，但在纸张回收过程中会无意中污染废水。由于其结构与内分泌干扰性芳香族有机化合物相似，人们担忧其对水生生物可能产生不利影响。我们通过芳基烃受体（AHR）聚焦于SRC效应，采用分子对接模拟和斑马鱼（Danio rerio）胚胎暴露评估。分子对接揭示，造纸回收废水中的某些SRCs与斑马鱼Ahr2和人类AHR之间具有增强的结合亲和力，这些是SRC毒性机制中的关键组成部分。受精斑马鱼卵在受精后暴露于SRCs长达96小时；在这些物质中，苄基2-萘基醚（BNE）在相对较低浓度（1 μM）下于胚胎发生期间引起了形态异常，如心包水肿和体长缩短。细胞色素P450 1A（cyp1a）和ahr2的基因表达也因BNE而显著增加。与AHR拮抗剂CH-223191共暴露仅部分缓解了BNE的表型效应，尽管2,3,7,8-四氯二苯并-p-二噁英的效应相对较好地由CH-223191恢复，表明BNE具有AHR非依赖性毒性机制。此外，包括BNE在内的某些SRCs在计算机模拟中表现出对雌激素受体的结合亲和力，并上调了cyp19a1b基因表达。因此，对SRCs及其机制的毒性进一步了解至关重要。本研究结果提供了关于SRCs及其他造纸化学品的重要信息，有助于最小化造纸工业的环境影响。环境毒理学与化学 2024；43:2176-2188.
